## What to download

| You have          | Download                           |
| ----------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| Windows           | `naughty-list-<version>-setup.exe` |
| Mac (M1/M2/M3/M4) | `naughty-list-<version>-arm64.dmg` |
| Mac (Intel)       | `naughty-list-<version>-x64.dmg`   |

Ignore the `.blockmap`, `.yml`, `.zip` and "Source code" files. They're for the auto-updater.

**Mac:** the app is unsigned. First launch: right-click → Open.
**Windows:** SmartScreen will warn once. More info → Run anyway.

Then: Crew tab → Sign in with Discord → paste the invite code.

Already installed? Windows updates itself on the next launch. Mac has to re-download (unsigned apps can't self-update).
